5.1.rationale: The cited operative provisions require a national action plan on domestic violence against women to include educational measures and awareness-raising, and also require dissemination/communication actions (including mass communication) aimed at delegitimizing violence against women—explicitly linking information/education/communication activities to preventing/eradicating violence against women.
